headlines.title: Dolores Huerta, farmworker and civil rights activist, dies at 96
headlines.description: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers with César Chávez, improving the lives of the country's mostly Latino farmworkers and changing the course of the labor movement.

headlines.title: They bought cabins to live on a cruise ship. High fuel costs got them kicked off in Cambodia.
headlines.description: Florida-based Villa Vie Residences said it was working to identify “temporary living arrangements” for people aboard The Odyssey, a 642-foot cruise ship.

headlines.title: Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro lands in Miami after refusing to surrender his passports
headlines.description: Brazilian Sen. Flavio Bolsonaro arrived in Miami after refusing to comply with a Brazilian Supreme Court order to surrender his passports as part of a money laundering investigation. NBC News' Monica Alba and Danny Cevallos break down the latest developments as Bolsonaro leaves Brazil following his electoral defeat.

headlines.title: Relentless rounds of high tides flood communities
headlines.description: Record-breaking high tides are inundating coastal neighborhoods in Florida and California. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports from the flood zone.

headlines.title: King tides flood communities along both U.S. coasts
headlines.description: Powerful king tides are flooding coastal communities in California and Florida, submerging streets and businesses as crews work to protect shorelines from rising water. NBC News’ Dana Griffin reports.

headlines.title: Manhunt underway for convicted murderer who escaped from Tennessee prison
headlines.description: Authorities are searching for Jacob Allen Morley, who escaped from a Tennessee prison while serving a life sentence for murder, and have released surveillance images of the escape. NBC News’ Aaron Gilchrist reports.

headlines.title: Jennifer Lawrence just launched a hair care line, and you can already save on the staples
headlines.description: Jennifer Lawrence launched Mes° hair care with three products: Multitask Repair Mask, Off-Duty Restyling Serum and Good Roots Volume Mist. If you buy the bundle, you get $10 off.

headlines.title: How to use every type of over-the-counter teeth whitening product (and which ones really work)
headlines.description: Experts share the best over-the-counter teeth whitening products of 2026 for a brighter smile, including Crest Whitestrips, Sensodyne and whitening pens.

headlines.title: 29 beauty Advent calendars so good you’ll open all the doors on the first day
headlines.description: Shop the best beauty Advent calendars across skin care, hair care, fragrances and more, from brands like E.l.f., Charlotte Tilbury, L’Occitane, and Jo Malone.

headlines.title: How to clean your vacuum and help it last for years, according to an expert
headlines.description: To learn how to clean a vacuum, I spoke to a home cleaning expert for their advice and recommendations. Here’s how to do it to make sure your appliance lasts.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Study estimates 75% of NFL players who died over 15-year span had CTE
headlines.description: An estimated 75% of professional football players who died over a 15-year span had signs of chronic traumatic encephalopathy, or CTE, a study published Wednesday found. It’s the highest estimation to date.
